demonstrates: a caseworker in one organisation, holding a valid case id belonging to another, received the same refusal as for a case that does not exist; a caller supplying the other organisation's id without a membership in it learned nothing either; and an account holding a real membership in both organisations, on a session scoped to the first, could not read or write the second's case — which is the only one of these the organisation predicate itself refuses, the rest being caught by the membership check
